questions.grammar_rule: Use 'an' before words starting with a vowel sound (a, e, i, o, u)
questions.grammar_rule_uz: 'An' unli tovush bilan boshlanadigan so'zlar oldidan ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: 'Apple' starts with a vowel sound, so we use 'an'

questions.grammar_rule: Use 'a' before words starting with a consonant sound
questions.grammar_rule_uz: 'A' undosh tovush bilan boshlanadigan so'zlar oldidan ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: 'Doctor' starts with a consonant sound 'd', so we use 'a'

questions.grammar_rule: Use 'the' for unique things (sun, moon, earth, sky)
questions.grammar_rule_uz: 'The' yagona narsalar uchun ishlatiladi (quyosh, oy, yer, osmon)
questions.explanation: There is only one sun, so we use 'the' (definite article)

questions.correct_answer: I saw an elephant at the zoo.
options: I saw an elephant at the zoo.
I saw a elephant at the zoo.
I saw elephant at the zoo.
I saw the elephant at a zoo.
questions.grammar_rule: 'An' before vowel sounds, 'the' for specific mentioned items
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Unli tovushlar oldidan 'an', ma'lum narsalar uchun 'the'
questions.explanation: 'Elephant' starts with a vowel, and 'the zoo' refers to a specific zoo

questions.sentence: I need ___ hour to finish this work.
questions.grammar_rule: Use 'an' before silent 'h' words where the vowel sound is first
questions.grammar_rule_uz: 'H' harfi tovushsiz bo'lsa va unli tovush bilan boshlansa 'an' ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: 'Hour' is pronounced with a silent 'h' (/aʊər/), starting with a vowel sound

questions.sentence: She plays a piano very well.
questions.correct_answer: She plays the piano very well.
questions.grammar_rule: Use 'the' with musical instruments when talking about playing them
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Musiqa asboblarini chalish haqida gapirganda 'the' ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: When talking about playing musical instruments, we use 'the' (play the piano/guitar/violin)

questions.grammar_rule: No article (zero article) with uncountable nouns in general statements
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Umumiy fikrlarda sanalab bo'lmaydigan otlar oldidan artikl ishlatilmaydi
questions.explanation: 'Coffee' in general (not specific) doesn't need an article

questions.grammar_rule: Use 'a' before words starting with a consonant SOUND (even if spelled with a vowel)
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Undosh TOVUSH bilan boshlanadigan so'zlar oldidan 'a' ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: 'University' starts with a /j/ consonant sound (yoo-ni-ver-si-ty), so we use 'a'

questions.grammar_rule: Use 'the' + adjective to refer to a group of people (the rich, the poor, the elderly)
questions.grammar_rule_uz: 'The' + sifat odamlar guruhini bildiradi (boylar, kambag'allar, qariyalar)
questions.explanation: 'The rich' and 'the poor' refer to groups of people as a whole

questions.sentence: I went to the school yesterday.
questions.grammar_rule: No article with places when referring to their primary purpose (school, church, hospital)
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Asosiy maqsad uchun ishlatilganda joy oldidan artikl qo'yilmaydi
questions.explanation: When referring to the purpose of school (to study), we don't use 'the'

questions.sentence: ___ Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
questions.grammar_rule: No article before proper nouns (names of mountains), but 'the' with superlatives
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Tog' nomlari oldidan artikl qo'yilmaydi, lekin ustunlik darajasi bilan 'the' ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: Mount Everest (proper noun) = no article; 'the highest' (superlative) = 'the'

questions.original_sentence: I bought (_) car. (_) car is red.
questions.correct_answer: I bought a car. The car is red.
questions.grammar_rule: First mention uses 'a/an', subsequent mentions use 'the'
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Birinchi marta aytilganda 'a/an', keyingi safar 'the' ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: First mention of 'car' uses 'a', then 'the car' because it's now specific

questions.grammar_rule: Use 'an' before words where 'h' is silent (honest, hour, heir)
questions.grammar_rule_uz: 'H' harfi jim bo'lgan so'zlar oldidan 'an' ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: 'Honest' has a silent 'h', starting with the vowel sound /ɒ/

questions.grammar_rule: No article with abstract nouns used in general sense
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Umumiy ma'noda ishlatilgan mavhum otlar oldidan artikl qo'yilmaydi
questions.explanation: 'Life' in a general philosophical sense doesn't need an article

questions.sentence: We traveled by ___ train through ___ Alps.
questions.grammar_rule: No article with 'by + transport', 'the' with mountain ranges
questions.grammar_rule_uz: 'By + transport' oldidan artikl yo'q, tog' tizimlari bilan 'the'
questions.explanation: 'By train' (transport) = no article; 'the Alps' (mountain range) = 'the'

questions.sentence: ___ Netherlands is famous for its tulips.
questions.grammar_rule: Use 'the' with country names that are plural or include 'Republic', 'Kingdom', etc.
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'plik yoki 'Respublika', 'Qirollik' so'zlari bo'lgan davlatlar bilan 'the'
questions.explanation: 'The Netherlands' takes 'the' because it's a plural country name

questions.sentence: She is in the hospital visiting her sick mother.
questions.correct_answer: She is in hospital visiting her sick mother.
questions.grammar_rule: British English: 'in hospital' (as patient), 'in the hospital' (as visitor) - context matters
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Britaniya ingliz tilida: 'in hospital' (bemor sifatida) va 'in the hospital' (mehmon)
questions.explanation: In British English, 'in hospital' is used when someone is there for medical care

questions.original_sentence: I play a guitar in the evening and read the books.
questions.correct_answer: I play the guitar in the evening and read books.
hints: General plural nouns don't need articles
questions.grammar_rule: The + musical instrument; no article for general plural nouns
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Musiqa asboblari bilan 'the'; umumiy ko'plik otlar uchun artikl yo'q
questions.explanation: 'Play the guitar' (instrument), 'read books' (books in general)

questions.sentence: She has ___ MBA from ___ Harvard University.
questions.grammar_rule: 'An' before abbreviations starting with vowel sounds; no article with university names
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Unli tovush bilan boshlanadigan qisqartmalar oldidan 'an'; universitet nomlari bilan artikl yo'q
questions.explanation: 'MBA' starts with /em/ (vowel sound), so 'an'; Harvard University = no article

questions.grammar_rule: Use 'a/an' in exclamations with 'What + (adjective) + singular noun!'
questions.grammar_rule_uz: 'What + sifat + birlik ot!' tuzilmasida 'a/an' ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: Exclamatory sentences: 'What a/an + adjective + noun!'
